summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine share repurchases under its previously announced second tranche 2026 buyback programme. The filing details transactions from May 26 to May 29, 2026, covering 333,700 own shares at an average price of NOK 344.0047 per share, bringing total holdings to 65,720,723 shares (2.57% of capital). No special-situation event is present; the buyback is an ordinary capital return programme, not a tender offer, going-private, or other special situation. The filing is a periodic disclosure under Norwegian law and EU Market Abuse Regulation. No deal terms or structural changes apply.
